newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Tight supplies push basis up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Tight supplies push basis up.

text.p: Tightening soymeal supplies caused by an increase in soy crushing plant downtime pushed some soymeal basis offers higher Thursday, U.S. brokers said.
"This market is getting real tight," said one Illinois dealer.
Processors have been active buyers of soymeal in cash markets in anticipation of an increase in crushing plant downtime during the first half of May, dealers said.
(Most) trade sources expect the National Oilseed Processors Association weekly crushing pace to fall substantially below last week's crush of 25.644 million bushels.
Trade estimates for the crush ranged from 24.1 to 24.9 million bushels.
Soymeal net weekly exports from the U.S. Department of Agriculture were better than expected at 90,200 tonnes. Traders had anticipated sales of 50,000 to 60,000 tonnes.
